name: drishti-agent
//: @effect/platform-node satisfies the hydrated @kolu/surface transports the agent serves and dials (peer-server's NodeStream/NodeSink stdio pair, unix-socket's NodeSocket). @preact/signals-core backs @kolu/surface/reactor — the reactive bridge the agent uses to fold the `alerts` cell. @kolu/surface and @kolu/surface-daemon are hydrated from the Nix store, not bun.lock — so the agent build, which excludes packages/app, must declare the runtime deps of those hydrated sources itself. `effect` backs the durable history ring schemas, surface-daemon's control core, and the whole RPC stack; it is pinned to the EXACT version the hydrated sources declare.
